The opening balances these reads return (and ledger_movement's movements) name no currency, so ComplyEaze Bridge refused before reading any ledger. ledger_masters with fields=compliance reads such a book through the base currency Tally identifies: it returns the plain base-currency ledgers and names the ones it leaves out (#551).
